description: Functions: signatures of ordered Parameters, each of some Entity, and at most one output Entity. A Function without an output gives nothing back; there is no Unit, which would have to belong to some Language. Interactions and Transformations are Functions. Extends Kernel.

axioms.about: A Parameter's next is a Parameter of the same Function
axioms.formula: all p in Parameter, n in p.next. n.function == p.function

axioms.about: A Function's Parameters have one first
axioms.formula: all f in Function, a in f.parameters, b in f.parameters. (no a.previous and no b.previous) => a == b

axioms.about: The Parameter chain has no cycles
axioms.formula: all p in Parameter. not p in p.^next
